name: What does the custom molding installation process involve?

mainEntity.name: What does the custom molding installation process involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project begins with on-site measurements, profile selection, and checking the plumb of your walls and ceilings. Finish carpenters locate wall framing studs, cut corners using coped joints or compound miters, and securely blind-nail the profiles into solid backing. Before finish trim can sit flush, bowing drywall or damaged framing must be corrected. HH Remodeling handles necessary drywall patches and framing adjustments directly on site. Once the molding is secured, the crew fills fastener holes, caulks seam lines along the drywall, and applies seamless finish paint so the trim blends cleanly into the surrounding room.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves measuring, adjusting wall framing or drywall, precision coping and cutting, fastening trim to studs, caulking, filling nail holes, and final painting.
